### ClassPass: Fitness, Spa, Salon {#review-app-4}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Precio y paywall.**
      6 reseñas recientes mencionan precio y paywall.
      Ventana de reseñas: 19 ago 2026 - 2 sept 2026
      **Por qué importa:** Mencionan precio, suscripciones o paywalls. Puede señalar sensibilidad al pricing en el nicho.

         **Ejemplos de reseñas:**
            1. _carabury_, 2 sept 2026, 1/5: "Be very careful with the “trial” — there’s an important restriction they don’t make clear. I signed up for a trial through a friend’s referral link and booked a class. I needed to reschedule and tried to do so within the permitted cancellation window. However, the app gave me no option to reschedule and instead told me I needed to sign up for the paid membership. I eventually had to Google the issue to find out why. Apparently, during the trial, you only get one appointment at a given location, and if you cancel that appointment—even within the allowed cancellation period—you lose the ability to book another one during the trial. That is a pretty significant restriction for a “trial,” and I don’t remember seeing it clearly disclosed when I signed up or booked the class. If the purpose of the trial is to let people experience the service, preventing someone from rescheduling a class they canceled within the allowed timeframe is incredibly frustrating. I contacted customer service hoping they could simply restore the trial booking. The chatbot was essentially useless, and when I finally reached a person, I was told they couldn’t help me. I would strongly recommend making this policy much more transparent. Customers shouldn’t have to Google the rules after the fact to discover that a permitted cancellation effectively uses up their entire trial. I’m leaving this review so other people know before they sign up: read the fine print, because “trial” apparently doesn’t mean you can freely reschedule your first class."
            2. _laurentm132_, 2 sept 2026, 5/5: "Update - after getting with customer service, I was able to address the issue with them and point out the amounts should be shown before being charged and got my rollover credits back. I do love this app and the ease I have when booking classes (and affordability) I will continue to use ClassPass. Thank you for making this right! I have used and loved ClassPass for months now. My schedule changed with my kids and funds got tighter with sports so I wanted to cancel my plan to downgrade it. I couldn’t downgrade it currently because I was past when I owed payment. I tried to cancel so I could downgrade and they offered me 20% off of my normal plan so I agreed because that was a good deal to be able to still take my classes. I took the deal and put just enough money in my account to cover the amount for the discounted monthly. I didn’t realize they only offered the discount towards my NEXT billing cycle next month and Apple Pay didn’t show me how much they were trying to bill me, so when I tried my card for the monthly, it declined and instead took money for the last few classes I had to late cancel when emergencies with my health kept coming up. Yes I understand I still need to pay those late fees, but my grievance is with the app not showing how much it’s going to charge you when updating payment and then charging you full price when you just tried to cancel because funds are tight. Now, I will not be renewing as 3 class cancellation fees came out to $75, I only had $110 in my account to pay for the discounted membership.i also lost my 11 credits because not only did they charge the late fees but they also emailed me that my subscription is now canceled. So now, my credits that were going to roll over are gone and my discount I was offered for 3 months is also gone. I am beside myself at their billing practice and cancelling my membership ON THEIR ACCORD, NOT MINE while I was confused."
<!--/ir-theme-->

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
